oe_ai2_jwr_distant_cross_continental = {
	join_war_disabled_trigger = {
		is_ai = yes
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		NOT = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_hegemon_ai_off }
		current_year < 1650
		exists = scope:first_leader
		exists = scope:second_leader
		NOT = { is_neighbor_of = scope:first_leader }
		NOT = { is_neighbor_of = scope:second_leader }
		navy_size < 15
		"border_distance_to(scope:second_leader)" > 1200
	}
}

oe_ai2_jwr_bankrupt_or_disaster_shield = {
	join_war_disabled_trigger = {
		is_ai = yes
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		NOT = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_hegemon_ai_off }
		exists = scope:second_leader
		NOT = { is_neighbor_of = scope:second_leader }
		OR = {
			is_during_bankruptcy = yes
			AND = {
				has_any_active_disaster = yes
				stability <= -15
			}
		}
	}
